## Architectures

<a id="delightfultts"></a>

### DelightfulTTS

Conformer acoustic model with explicit and implicit prosody.

[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2110.12612)

![DelightfulTTS — Figure 1](../assets/architectures/delightfultts.png)

*Figure 1 · [Source](https://arxiv.org/abs/2110.12612)*

<details>
<summary>Details</summary>

**Input → output:** T → S · **Interaction:** generation

Predicts acoustic features and variation factors, then uses HiFiNet to synthesize higher-sample-rate audio.

</details>

<a id="emotivoice"></a>

### EmotiVoice

PromptTTS-derived style and content conditioning.

[Repository](https://github.com/netease-youdao/EmotiVoice)

![EmotiVoice — Input/output diagram](../assets/architectures/emotivoice.svg)

*Input/output diagram · [Source](https://github.com/netease-youdao/EmotiVoice)*

<details>
<summary>Details</summary>

**Input → output:** T → S · **Interaction:** generation

Released English and Chinese synthesizers accept text prompts describing emotion and delivery. Voice adaptation is a separate training workflow.

Editorial summary of documented inputs and outputs; internal architecture is not shown.

</details>

<a id="fastpitch"></a>

### FastPitch

Parallel Transformer with explicit pitch prediction.

[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2006.06873)

![FastPitch — Figure 1](../assets/architectures/fastpitch.png)

*Figure 1 · [Source](https://arxiv.org/abs/2006.06873)*

<details>
<summary>Details</summary>

**Input → output:** T → S · **Interaction:** generation

Predicts token durations and pitch before mel-spectrogram generation; pitch predictions can be edited to control delivery.

</details>

<a id="fastspeech"></a>

### FastSpeech

Feed-forward Transformer and duration-based length regulator.

[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/1905.09263)

![FastSpeech — Figure 1, PDF p. 4](../assets/architectures/fastspeech.png)

*Figure 1, PDF p. 4 · [Source](https://arxiv.org/abs/1905.09263)*

<details>
<summary>Details</summary>

**Input → output:** T → S · **Interaction:** generation

Generates mel frames in parallel using durations learned from an autoregressive teacher, followed by a vocoder.

</details>

<a id="fastspeech-2"></a>

### FastSpeech 2

Parallel Transformer with duration, pitch and energy prediction.

[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2006.04558)

![FastSpeech 2 — Figure 1, PDF p. 3](../assets/architectures/fastspeech-2.png)

*Figure 1, PDF p. 3 · [Source](https://arxiv.org/abs/2006.04558)*

<details>
<summary>Details</summary>

**Input → output:** T → S · **Interaction:** generation

Learns from ground-truth speech without teacher distillation. FastSpeech 2s adds a parallel waveform decoder.

**Variants:** FastSpeech 2s.

</details>

<a id="jets"></a>

### JETS

Joint FastSpeech 2 and HiFi-GAN with learned alignment.

[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2203.16852)

![JETS — Figure 1, PDF p. 2](../assets/architectures/jets.png)

*Figure 1, PDF p. 2 · [Source](https://arxiv.org/abs/2203.16852)*

<details>
<summary>Details</summary>

**Input → output:** T → S · **Interaction:** generation

Trains the acoustic model and waveform generator together, avoiding a separately supplied text-speech alignment.

</details>

<a id="parallel-tacotron"></a>

### Parallel Tacotron

Parallel acoustic model with a variational residual encoder.

[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2010.11439)

![Parallel Tacotron — Figure 1](../assets/architectures/parallel-tacotron.png)

*Figure 1 · [Source](https://arxiv.org/abs/2010.11439)*

<details>
<summary>Details</summary>

**Input → output:** T → S · **Interaction:** generation

Uses lightweight convolutions and residual variation modeling to generate mel spectrograms, followed by a neural vocoder.

</details>

<a id="parallel-tacotron-2"></a>

### Parallel Tacotron 2

Parallel synthesis with differentiable duration modeling.

[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2103.14574)

![Parallel Tacotron 2 — Figure 1](../assets/architectures/parallel-tacotron-2.png)

*Figure 1 · [Source](https://arxiv.org/abs/2103.14574)*

<details>
<summary>Details</summary>

**Input → output:** T → S · **Interaction:** generation

Learns alignment and token durations through differentiable upsampling and a Soft-DTW reconstruction objective.

</details>

<a id="prompttts"></a>

### PromptTTS

Style and content text encoders with a speech decoder.

[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2211.12171)

![PromptTTS — Figure 1](../assets/architectures/prompttts.png)

*Figure 1 · [Source](https://arxiv.org/abs/2211.12171)*

<details>
<summary>Details</summary>

**Input → output:** T → S · **Interaction:** generation

Accepts a spoken script plus a natural-language description of the desired voice and delivery.

</details>

<a id="speedyspeech"></a>

### SpeedySpeech

Residual convolutional acoustic model with duration expansion.

[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2008.03802)

![SpeedySpeech — Figure 3](../assets/architectures/speedyspeech.png)

*Figure 3 · [Source](https://arxiv.org/abs/2008.03802)*

<details>
<summary>Details</summary>

**Input → output:** T → S · **Interaction:** generation

A teacher provides durations for the parallel student; a MelGAN vocoder converts predicted spectrograms to audio.

</details>

<a id="styletts"></a>

### StyleTTS

Style-conditioned parallel synthesis with a transferable aligner.

[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2205.15439)

![StyleTTS — Figure 1](../assets/architectures/styletts.png)

*Figure 1 · [Source](https://arxiv.org/abs/2205.15439)*

<details>
<summary>Details</summary>

**Input → output:** T, S → S · **Interaction:** generation

Extracts speaking style from reference speech and predicts duration, pitch and energy for acoustic generation.

</details>
